cuisinejournal.effect.appetizing.descrip: Adds 2 temporary food capacity. Temporary food lasts 10 seconds and heals in combat without increasing maximum health. Re-eating refreshes matching food, other food replaces by capacity, and each serving can trigger instant effects again.
cuisinejournal.effect.digesting.descript: Eat even when ordinary food cannot be added or refreshed. Extra food takes its normal eating time multiplied by 2 and its slot cost, then instantly heals its maximum-health contribution without increasing maximum health. Appetizing also allows temporary food placement.
cuisinejournal.effect.nourishment.descri: Out-of-combat recovery increases by 25%. In combat, recover 50% of the out-of-combat amount before Nourishment. Temporary food recovery and other healing are unaffected. Other effects may consume the remaining Nourishment duration.
